description: Publish a release note to your LogPulse changelog right after shipping — with version, breaking changes, migration steps and deprecations. Needs a LogPulse API key with the “Publish releases” permission, sent as the Authorization header.

author_name.description: Shown as the author. Defaults to the API key's name.

breaking_changes.description: What breaks for existing users, each with migration steps.

affects.description: What is affected, e.g. REST API, @acme/sdk.

category.description: new, improved or fixed. Default new.

deprecations.description: What is deprecated, its replacement and planned removal version.

labels.description: Up to 10 short labels, e.g. API, Dashboard.

published_at.description: Schedule a future time, or backdate an import.

slug.description: URL slug. Defaults to the title.

status.description: published (default) goes live now, or at published_at. draft saves it for a human to review in LogPulse.

summary.description: One sentence for lists and link previews.

title.description: Short, user-facing headline, e.g. “Webhooks retry automatically”.

version.description: Version this release ships in, e.g. 2.0.0. Unique per changelog.

name: publish_release
title: Publish release
